text: 金十数据11月10日讯，盈趣科技公告，控股股东深圳万利达电子工业有限公司(万利达工业)此前计划自2026年10月24日起6个月内，通过集中竞价方式增持公司股份，增持总金额不低于人民币1亿元。2026年11月10日，万利达工业通过深圳证券交易所交易系统以集中竞价方式首次增持公司股份68.39万股，占公司总股本的0.09%，增持金额为1306.73万元(不含交易费用)。首次增持后，万利达工业持有公司股票3.89亿股，占公司总股本的50.43%；万利达工业及其一致行动人合计持有公司股票4.3亿股，占公司总股本的55.66%。本次增持计划尚未实施完毕，万利达工业
text_en: Jinshi Data, November 10 - Xiamen Intretech announced that its controlling shareholder, Shenzhen Malata Electronic Industry Co., Ltd. (Malata Industrial), had previously planned to increase its shareholding in the company through centralized bidding within 6 months starting from October 24, 2026, with a total increase amount of no less than 100 million yuan. On November 10, 2026, Malata Industrial made its first increase in the company's shares through the Shenzhen Stock Exchange trading system by centralized bidding, purchasing 683,900 shares, accounting for 0.09% of the company's total share capital, with an increase amount of 13.0673 million yuan (excluding transaction fees). After the first increase, Malata Industrial held 389 million shares of the company, accounting for 50.43% of the company's total share capital; Malata Industrial and its concert parties together held 430 million shares, accounting for 55.66% of the company's total share capital.
